name: Lexington Law
description_short: Lexington Law is a credit repair law firm that disputes errors and negative items on credit reports using licensed attorneys and paralegals, claiming 84 million removals since 2004.
description_long:
Lexington Law has operated as a credit repair firm since 2004, positioning itself as a law firm-based alternative to traditional credit repair companies. The company claims to have served nearly 11 million clients and achieved over 84 million item removals across collections, late payments, charge-offs, and other negative marks. Their core business model centers on disputing inaccurate or unverifiable items on credit reports by leveraging consumer protection laws and formal agreements with credit bureaus.

The company offers dispute services backed by licensed attorneys and skilled paralegals who handle client cases. Services include a free credit assessment with FICO score review, personalized credit improvement strategies, monthly Transunion FICO score updates via a mobile app, real-time progress tracking, phone support, and $1 million identity theft insurance coverage. They claim no long-term contracts and allow clients to cancel anytime, with first payment due 5 days after sign-up. According to their marketing, 50% of negative items are removed within 6 months for clients with moderately damaged credit who stay active.

Lexington Law distinguishes itself through its attorney-led approach and claims of four U.S. Patent and Trademark Office patents for proprietary credit dispute strategies. The company emphasizes decades of experience and formal relationships with credit bureaus. They provide detailed educational content on credit repair, dispute processes, credit laws, and negative item removal strategies across their website.

While the company presents strong removal statistics and client testimonials, consumers should note that results vary significantly by case, and the company's promises are limited to communicating with creditors on behalf of clients, verifying report changes, and providing timely information—not guaranteed removals. The reliance on client testimonials and the conditional nature of results (tied to client activity and case-specific factors) warrants realistic expectations about outcomes.
pros: Licensed attorneys and paralegals handle disputes, providing legal backing
Claims 84 million removals since 2004 with detailed removal breakdowns (50M collections, 13M late payments, 9.5M charge-offs)
Free credit assessment including FICO score review and personalized credit solution recommendations
No long-term contracts; clients can cancel anytime with first payment due 5 days after sign-up
Monthly Transunion FICO score updates and mobile app for real-time progress tracking
$1 million identity theft insurance coverage included
Four U.S. patents for proprietary credit dispute strategies
cons: Results are highly variable and dependent on case specifics and client activity level; company explicitly states 50% removal rate applies only to moderately damaged credit with sustained client engagement
Company promises are narrowly limited to communication, verification, and information—not guaranteed item removals
Paid service with ongoing monthly fees after initial 5-day free period; total cost structure not clearly outlined on homepage
Testimonials are self-selected and come from unspecified subsets of the client base; no independent third-party verification of removal rates
The patent claims and 20+ year history, while impressive, do not guarantee superior outcomes compared to other credit repair approaches or DIY disputes
best_for: Consumers with 2-4 negative items on their credit report seeking professional legal representation for disputes
People who prefer attorney-backed credit repair over DIY dispute letters or non-legal credit repair companies
Individuals willing to actively engage with their credit improvement process over several months
Those seeking organized progress tracking and monthly score updates via mobile app
diagnosis: Lexington Law is best for consumers with moderate credit damage who want attorney-backed dispute representation and are comfortable paying for professional services over several months. The main caveat is that results are highly variable and not guaranteed—success depends on the specific items on your report, the bureaus' verification processes, and your sustained engagement with the service.
services: Free credit assessment with FICO score review and credit report summary
Dispute of inaccurate or unverifiable negative items on credit reports
Attorney and paralegal representation in credit disputes
Mobile app with real-time progress tracking
Educational content on credit repair, credit laws, and dispute processes
Assistance with charge-offs, late payments, collections, bankruptcies, foreclosures, repossessions, judgments, and medical bills
